lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular matrix across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into roughly parallel horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like pattern of high-contrast anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch-like indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral and lateral surfaces of the shark's body.
